definitions.area: Actual exclusive area strictly greater than zero and below40m². Exactly40m² is excluded; <=40 is a separate sensitivity.
definitions.time: Sale2010–2026; rental2011–2026. Completed calendar years and matching January–June/August/September windows. No full2026 or2010rental observation is invented.
definitions.population: Valid cleaned apartment API contract events; unkeyed rentals and valid ambiguous contract/right/term disclosures retained. No unique-home/household/demand interpretation.
definitions.geography: Canonical complex region where available, existing preserved record geography otherwise. Seoul25districts and36collectedGyeonggi areas; not allGyeonggi or national coverage.
definitions.markets: Sale, jeonse(zero monthly payment), monthly(positive monthly payment), with valid nonnegative deposit/payment and positive total consideration.
definitions.sale_settings: Invariant includes observed cancellation/direct labels; strict excludes them. Historical blank labels are not confirmed ordinary trades. No rental cancellation variable is invented.
definitions.within_province: Regional <40 contract events divided by the same province/window/market <40 events;2percentage-point intervals.
definitions.within_market: Regional or provincial <40 events divided by all-area events in the same window/market;5percentage-point intervals.
definitions.rental: (jeonse+monthly)/(sale+jeonse+monthly) for the indicated area/population;5percentage-point intervals. Not monthly share among rentals.
definitions.cohorts: native_era uses individually verified reported construction year. era uses current canonical year as a separate sensitivity. Unknown/future/invalid reported years are not filled; neither field proves actual occupancy or legal approval date.
definitions.classification: Current linked Kapt label strings, including urban-living variants and other/missing labels. Urban-living and apartments are not mutually exclusive legal types; current labels are not historical legal use.
definitions.complete_cases: classified selects four explicitly named current labels; known_era selects known current canonical cohort. These subsets are sensitivities, not corrected market estimates.
definitions.intervals: Closed conservative ranges, not confidence intervals.2pp geography,5pp within-market/rental,10pp attributes/coverage/boundary. Derive comparisons solely from displayed endpoints.
definitions.missing: Null is a common withheld state, never zero or a last-place rank. At least100 denominator events and at least20 events for positive numerator/complement contributions are required. Actual zero/full share use the endpoint intervals.
definitions.concentration: Event weights are not equal complex/home weights. Unknown complex identity can contain concentration; no fictitious entities or representative-complex claim.

limitations: Observed reporting/fixed-date rental events, not all residents, dwellings, current listings or unique contracts per home.
Current retained vintage; September2026 and recent records are provisional. Reporting rules and composition can change over time.
No causal inference, rent yield, future demand or personalized purchase recommendation.
Rounded public arrays retain all prespecified periods and areas, with unknown classifications and withheld intervals explicitly preserved.
